<thought>Based on the 1H NMR data, the molecule likely consists of a methyl group attached to an aromatic ring (singlet at 2.23 ppm, 3 H), a –CH₂–CH₂– linker (two triplets, 2 H each, J ≈ 7 Hz), and two aromatic rings giving a total of 9 aromatic protons (7 H at 7.17 ppm and 2 H at 7.90 ppm). This matches a structure where a tolyl group is connected via a phenethyl chain to an unsubstituted phenyl ring: Cc1ccccc1CCc2ccccc2. This SMILES accounts for all observed protons (3 + 4 + 9 = 16 H) and fits the chemical shift patterns.</thought>
<final_answer>Cc1ccccc1CCc2ccccc2</final_answer>
